sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: SATELLITE SHOWS GRT BASIN UPR LOW DEVOLVING INTO A SHORTWAVE TROUGH ATTM AS UPSTREAM DISTURBANCE AMPLIFIES SE ALONG THE BC CST. THIS PROCESS SHOULD CONTINUE THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE PERIOD...WITH VORT MAX IN THE BASE OF THE TROUGH /NOW OVER SRN NV/ ACCELERATING ENE ACROSS NRN AZ/NM TODAY...AND THEN NNE ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLNS EARLY TUE. AT LWR LVLS...LEE LOW AND TRAILING TROUGH/DRY LINE EXPECTED TO REMAIN NEARLY STNRY OVER ERN CO TODAY...BEFORE DEEPENING AND ACCELERATING NNE INTO SW SD BY 12Z TUE. THE LOW WILL OVERTAKE POLAR FRONT ATTM EXTENDING FROM THE CNTRL HIGH PLNS ENE TO THE UPR GRT LKS/NEW ENGLAND...AND WILL DRIVE THE WRN END OF THAT BOUNDARY NWD ACROSS NEB AS A WARM FRONT. MOVEMENT OF THE REMAINING PORTION OF THE BOUNDARY WILL BE MORE COMPLEX...DICTATED BY STRENGTH AND MOTION OF SFC WAVE NOW OVER NRN MI.

sections.title: NM/ERN CO NNE INTO PARTS OF KS/NEB/SE WY TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL MARKEDLY INCREASE OVER NRN/ERN NM AND ERN CO LATER TODAY...AND OVER WRN KS AND WRN/CNTRL NEB TNGT...AS NV VORT MAX EVOLVES INTO A POTENT...PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH. COUPLED WITH AN ASSOCIATED INCREASE IN WINDS ACROSS THE REGION...AND AT LEAST A MODEST INFLUX OF MOISTURE...SETUP APPEARS FAVORABLE FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF SVR STORMS CAPABLE OF SVR WIND...HAIL...AND TORNADOES. SCTD TO NUMEROUS TSTMS SHOULD FORM BY EARLY-MID AFTN OVER CNTRL/ERN NM AND SRN CO IN RESPONSE TO SFC HEATING AND INCREASING MID-LVL COOLING/ASCENT OVER HIGHER TERRAIN AND ALONG LEE TROUGH. WITH SBCAPE AOA 1000 J/KG AND 700-500 MB FLOW ON THE ORDER OF 40-50 KTS...AT LEAST A FEW SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS APPEAR LIKELY. THESE MAY YIELD LARGE HAIL...DMGG WIND...AND...GIVEN LONGER-LIVED DISCRETE STORMS AND/OR FAVORABLE STORM-SCALE INTERACTIONS...A COUPLE TORNADOES. THE CONVECTION SHOULD MERGE INTO A FAIRLY EXTENSIVE...ENE-MOVING SQLN BY EARLY EVE THAT ALSO DEVELOPS NWD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF ERN CO. NNE ACCELERATION OF THE UPR VORT...AND MODEST BUT PERSISTENT LOW-LVL MOISTURE RETURN /SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPR 50S F WITH PW AOA 1 INCH/ SUGGEST THAT DMGG WIND/ISOLD TORNADO TH

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLE TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT OVER PARTS OF THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A MID TO UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER THE GREAT BASIN WILL EVOLVE INTO A NEGATIVELY TILTED OPEN WAVE AS A SIGNIFICANT VORTICITY MAXIMUM AND ASSOCIATED 50-60 KT JET STREAK AT 500 MB OVER THE LOWER CO VALLEY ACCELERATES NEWD THROUGH THE FOUR CORNERS REGION THIS AFTERNOON BEFORE REACHING THE CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS LATE TONIGHT INTO EARLY TUESDAY. AT THE SURFACE...A LEE CYCLONE WILL DEEPEN SLIGHTLY TODAY OVER ERN CO BEFORE UNDERGOING MORE SUBSTANTIAL INTENSIFICATION TONIGHT WHILE DEVELOPING NWD THROUGH THE NEB PNHDL INTO WRN SD. THE EVOLUTION OF THIS SURFACE LOW MAY ALLOW FOR SOME NWD MOVEMENT OF A POLAR FRONT OVER PARTS OF THE CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS. FARTHER TO THE SW...A PACIFIC FRONT WILL STRENGTHEN WHILE MOVING THROUGH THE CNTRL AND SRN ROCKIES WITH THIS FEATURE REACHING THE CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS TONIGHT.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING DATA FROM THE CNTRL/SRN ROCKIES EWD INTO GREAT PLAINS INDICATED THE PRESENCE OF MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES GENERALLY LESS THAN 6.5 C/KM ATOP MARGINAL BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE CONTENT WITH LOWEST 100-MB MEAN-MIXING RATIOS OF 9-11 G/KG. THESE FACTORS WILL LIMIT THE POTENTIAL FOR SUBSTANTIAL AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION TODAY...THOUGH ABUNDANT SUNSHINE SHOULD BOOST MLCAPE VALUES INTO THE 500-1500 J/KG RANGE BY AFTERNOON. HEATING ALONG THE HIGH TERRAIN COUPLED WITH INCREASING HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA ASSOCIATED WITH THE MIGRATORY SHORT-WAVE TROUGH SHOULD FOSTER SCATTERED STORM DEVELOPMENT BY EARLY TO MID AFTERNOON OVER CNTRL NM WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS FORMING SHORTLY THEREAFTER ALONG THE FOOTHILLS OF THE I-25 CORRIDOR IN CO. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR STRENGTHENING TO 40-50 KT SHOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AS THE INITIAL STORM MODE WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARDS BEING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL EXIST OVER NERN CO PERHAPS INTO SWRN NEB OWING TO LOCALLY BACKED NEAR-SURFACE FLOW INVOF THE NWD-MIGRATING SURFACE LOW. HOWEVER...THIS THREAT WILL BE CONDITIONAL ON THE EROSION AND NWD RETREAT OF THE SHALLOW POLAR AIR MASS WHICH IS PRESENT ACROSS TH

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLE TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT OVER PARTS OF THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS. THE ONLY CHANGE TO THE OUTLOOK HAS BEEN AN ADJUSTMENT TO THE 30 PERCENT SEVERE WIND PROBABILITY AREA TO INCLUDE PARTS OF SERN CO. STRONG SURFACE HEATING HAS RESULTED IN TEMPS RISING INTO THE 80S AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OVER SERN CO IMMEDIATELY DOWNSTREAM OF THE EJECTING MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX. THE PRECONDITIONING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER FOR MOMENTUM TRANSPORT MAY RESULT IN A SLIGHTLY GREATER WIND THREAT THAN PREVIOUSLY FORECAST. ..SMITH.. 09/29/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1119 AM CDT MON SEP 29 2014/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO SPREAD EAST/NORTHEAST FROM THE MOUNTAINS OF NM/CO THIS AFTERNOON. EXPECT THIS ACTIVITY TO INTENSIFY AND ORGANIZE THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON WITH DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL POTENTIAL INCREASING FROM NORTHEAST NM ACROSS SOUTHEAST CO. A WATCH APPEARS LIKELY BY 20 UTC/2 PM MDT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A POTENT SHORTWAVE DISTURBANCE OVER THE FOUR-CORNERS WAS ROUNDING THE BASE OF A LARGE-SCALE DEEP-LAYER CYCLONE CENTERED OVER THE GREAT BASIN. STRONGLY FORCED ASCENT WITH THIS DISTURBANCE WAS EVIDENT IN LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AS A LAYERED COMMA-HEAD CLOUD STRUCTURE TRACKING TOWARD THE FOUR-CORNERS. ISOLATED CONVECTIVE INITIATION HAS BEEN UNDERWAY WITHIN THE WEAKLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS AHEAD OF THE COMMA-HEAD/VORT MAX...FROM NORTHWEST NM INTO SOUTH-CENTRAL CO. EXPECT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO AS STRONGER DYNAMIC FORCING AND LOWERING STATIC STABILITY SPREAD EAST/NORTHEAST. AIRMASS ALONG AND EAST OF THE FRONT RANGE HAS BEEN WARMING INTO THE 70S F IN MOST AREAS. LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE RETURN TO THESE AREAS HAS BEEN ADEQUATE WITH SURFACE DEWPOINTS GENERALLY RISING THROUGH THE LOW-MID 50S F. STEEPENING LOW THROUGH MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL CONTRIBUTE TO FURTHER DESTABILIZATION COINCIDENT WITH THE ARRIVAL OF STRONGER ASCENT TO SUPPORT A CORRIDOR OF MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 500 J/KG. CONVECTION INCREASING IN AREAL COVERAGE AND DEVELOPING EAST FROM THE MOUNTAINS TO ADJACENT FOOTHILLS AND PLAINS SHOULD GRADUALLY INTENSIFY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL ALSO STRENGTHEN AS THE SHORTWAVE AND ASSOCIATED 50-60KT MID-LEVEL JET STREAK TRACK EAST/NORTHEAST. WHILE INITIALLY CELLULAR/DISCRETE...WITH TIME STORMS MAY TEND CONCENTRATE ALONG/NEAR STRENGTHENING LEE-TROUGH/LOW GRADUALLY STRENGTHENING OVER EASTERN CO/NORTHEAST NM. GIVEN 40-60KT EFFECTIVE VERTICAL SHEAR AND ORIENTATION OF MID-LEVEL JET ACROSS THE LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE AXIS...INITIALLY CELLULAR CONVECTION MAY TEND TO EVOLVE INTO FAST-MOVING LINE SEGMENTS AS THE AFTERNOON PROGRESSES. IN ADDITION TO SOME CHANCE FOR SEVERE HAIL AROUND 1 INCH IN DIAMETER...SCATTERED DAMAGING

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ORGANIZED THUNDERSTORMS WITH HAIL...HIGH WINDS...AND POSSIBLY A COUPLE TORNADOES...ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS NORTHEAST CO THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON. THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO EXPAND AND SPREAD NORTHEAST INTO ADJACENT AREAS OF NEB AND KS BY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A POTENT SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL EJECT NORTHEAST FROM THE FOUR CORNERS AREA AND ACROSS EASTERN CO THROUGH THIS EVENING. IN ADDITION TO CONTRIBUTING TO LEE-SIDE CYCLOGENESIS OVER THE EASTERN PLAINS OF CO...INTENSIFYING DEEP-LAYER ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS DISTURBANCE WILL ACT ON A SUFFICIENTLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS TO SUPPORT ROBUST THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. ACTIVITY CURRENTLY INCREASING ACROSS THE MOUNTAINS SHOULD CONTINUE TO SPREAD EAST/NORTHEAST AND STRENGTHEN AS FORCING AND DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR INTENSIFY WITH THE APPROACH OF THE MID/UPPER SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND SPEED MAX. CONTINUED HEATING/DESTABILIZATION EAST OF THE FRONT RANGE...AND COINCIDENT WITH LEE-LOW DEVELOPMENT ALONG QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY FROM THE PALMER DIVIDE NORTHEASTWARD...MAY LEAD TO ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. GIVEN MAGNITUDE OF FOCUSED FORCING AND ADEQUATE INSTABILITY...STORM-SCALE GUIDANCE FROM NAM4 TO HRRR TO WRF-ARW ARE QUITE CONSISTENT IN DEPICTING A RAPID INCREASE IN SUPERCELL POTENTIAL OVER NORTHEAST CO IN THE 21-23 UTC/3-5 PM MDT TIME FRAME. THESE SCENARIOS APPEAR REASONABLE GIVEN CONTINUED HEATING/DESTABILIZATION AND PRESENCE OF BACKED LOW LEVEL FLOW THAT SHOULD PERSIST NEAR THE DEVELOPING LEE-LOW AND ALONG THE QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY...AS THE STRONGER DYNAMIC FORCING BEGINS TO EMERGE OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE CHANCE FOR SEVERE STORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL SHOULD INCREASE OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS FROM NORTHEAST NM INTO SOUTHEAST CO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEE CYCLOGENESIS WAS UNDERWAY ACROSS EASTERN CO AS A POTENT SHORTWAVE TROUGH EJECTS NORTHEASTWARD FROM THE FOUR CORNERS. CONVECTIVE COVERAGE HAS INCREASED MARKEDLY OVER NORTH-CENTRAL NM AND THE CO FRONT RANGE OVER THE PAST FEW HOURS...AND EXPECT THESE TRENDS TO CONTINUE AS THE STRONG DISTURBANCE DEVELOPS ACROSS ROCKIES THROUGH THE EVENING. MASS RESPONSE TO PRESSURE FALLS IN THE LEE OF THE ROCKIES HAS ALREADY RESULTED IN A STRENGTHENING OF LOW-LEVEL WINDS OVER NM/CO WHERE SURFACE GUSTS AWAY FROM DEEP CONVECTION WERE ALREADY APPROACHING 40KT. EXPECT DEVELOPING BANDS/LINES OF STORMS WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE WIND GUSTS APPROACHING 50KT AS CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING ALLOWS HIGHER MOMENTUM AIR ALOFT TO REACH THE SURFACE. MORE DISCRETE/CELLULAR CONVECTION HAS BEEN MORE ISOLATED BUT SHEAR AND INSTABILITY WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SOME CHANCE FOR HAIL WITH STORMS OF THIS CHARACTER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL CONTINUES ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL AND NORTHEAST COLORADO...AND ADJACENT SOUTHEAST WYOMING/SOUTHWEST NEBRASKA...THROUGH 03Z. THIS INCLUDES A WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY FOR INCREASING TORNADIC POTENTIAL ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF NORTHEAST COLORADO. AT THE PRESENT TIME...IT APPEARS THAT A NEW WW MAY NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BENEATH DIVERGENT UPPER FLOW IN THE LEFT EXIT REGION OF THE STRONG CYCLONIC MID/UPPER JET STREAK...NOW NOSING ACROSS THE ROCKIES INTO THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...SCATTERED VIGOROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT IS ONGOING ACROSS MUCH OF CENTRAL/NORTHEAST COLORADO. THIS INCLUDES A FEW DISCRETE SUPERCELLS IN THE PRESENCE OF MODEST MIXED LAYER CAPE UP TO 1000 J/KG AND STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR. STRONGER LINEAR LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC FORCING FOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS CURRENTLY CROSSING THE COLORADO SPRINGS AND TRINIDAD AREA...AND APPEARS LIKELY TO CONTINUE ADVANCING NORTHEAST OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN INTO THE EASTERN COLORADO STATE BORDER AREA THROUGH THE 01-03Z TIME FRAME. AS THIS OCCURS...A WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY APPEARS TO EXIST FOR THE EVOLUTION OF AN UPSCALE GROWING/INTENSIFYING SQUALL LINE...BEFORE ENCOUNTERING INFLOW OF MORE STABLE OR STABILIZING /WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING/ BOUNDARY LAYER AIR AS IT APPROACHES WESTERN KANSAS/SOUTHWESTERN NEBRASKA. UNTIL BEING OVERTAKEN BY THE APPROACHING STRONGER LINEAR FORCING...DISCRETE STORM DEVELOPMENT LIKELY WILL PERSIST ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS ACROSS AND EAST OF THE LIMON/AKRON AREAS. SOUTHERLY 850 MB FLOW IS IN THE PROCESS OF STRENGTHENING FROM 30-50 KTS ACROSS THIS REGION...AND ENLARGING LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS COULD STILL SUPPORT A PERIOD OF INCREASING TORNADIC POTENTIAL... BEFORE THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING BEGINS TO STABILIZE THE INFLOW SOURCE REGION. ..KERR.. 09/29/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DMGG WIND AND ISOLATED SVR HAIL POTENTIAL WILL PERSIST FOR THE NEXT COUPLE ACROSS PARTS OF THE SRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. THE DMGG WIND THREAT MAY EXTEND SLIGHTLY E OF WW 509 ACROSS SWRN KS...BUT A NEW WW DOES NOT APPEAR NECESSARY AS POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO DECREASE AFTER 02-03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC IMAGERY SHOWS ISOLATED DISCRETE SUPERCELLS PERSISTING ACROSS NERN NM...APPROACHING THE NWRN TX AND WRN OK PANHANDLES...POSING A THREAT FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS AND LOCALLY SVR HAIL. STORMS ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF THE WW IN E-CNTRL NM HAVE EXHIBITED SLOW WEAKENING TRENDS OVER THE PAST HR. FARTHER N/W...CONVECTION CONTINUES TO INCREASE ALONG A PACIFIC COLD FRONT FROM SERN CO SWWD INTO NERN NM...AS A MIDLEVEL JET STREAK IS EJECTING NEWD FROM N-CNTRL NM. THIS ACTIVITY IS PROGRESSING EWD INTO A MORE MARGINAL THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT /SEE 00Z AMA SOUNDING/...CHARACTERIZED BY LOW 50S F SFC DEWPOINTS...WITH BUOYANCY FORECAST TO DECREASE FURTHER OWING TO NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING. FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE EJECTING JET STREAK SHOULD BECOME INCREASINGLY FOCUSED N OF THE MCD AREA INTO NERN CO OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS. THESE FACTORS ARE EXPECTED TO LIMIT THE EWD PROGRESSION OF A CONVECTIVE WIND THREAT TO WITHIN OR JUST E OF WW 509...PERHAPS EXTENDING INTO FAR SWRN KS THIS EVENING. A NEW WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED. ..ROGERS.. 09/30/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
